trace-spans.title: Related timing boundaries
trace-spans.summary: A parent contains child work; overlapping child elapsed durations are not added to the parent.

nodes.label: Request span 150 ms
nodes.description: Parent boundary: user operation on the API.

nodes.label: Parse 0–10 ms
nodes.description: First child prepares input.

nodes.label: Call A 10–100 ms
nodes.description: One parallel dependency finishes earlier.

nodes.label: Call B 10–130 ms
nodes.description: The slower parallel dependency determines readiness.

nodes.label: Assembly 130–150 ms
nodes.description: Finish after both required calls; the path through B dominates.

sli-slo-budget.title: From events to an error budget
sli-slo-budget.summary: Good and eligible events must share the same scope and window.

nodes.label: Eligible user events
nodes.description: Define operation, population, window and exclusions.

nodes.label: Good events
nodes.description: Apply correctness and latency criteria consistently.

nodes.label: Observed SLI
nodes.description: Good divided by eligible; no data is unknown.

nodes.label: Target allowance
nodes.description: Allowed bad fraction equals one minus SLO target.

nodes.label: Budget use
nodes.description: Compare observed bad events with allowed bad events for the window.

incident-runbook.title: Investigate and confirm recovery
incident-runbook.summary: Each hypothesis predicts evidence, and recovery is verified through the same user outcome.

nodes.label: User impact
nodes.description: Establish affected operations and start time.

nodes.label: Signals and timeline
nodes.description: Compare releases, latency, errors and saturation.

nodes.label: Test a hypothesis
nodes.description: Choose evidence that distinguishes a possible cause.

nodes.label: Recovery action
nodes.description: Use the runbook to mitigate or roll back with an owner.

nodes.label: Verify outcome
nodes.description: Repeat the task and check that backlog and failures recover.
